title.narrative: Country Programme for inclusive and sustainable industrial development in Armenia 2022-2026

description.narrative: The Country Programme (CP) 2022-2026 has been developed to set up the programmatic vision and strategy for the engagement and partnership for inclusive and sustainable industrial development (ISID) between the Government of Armenia and the United Nations Industrial Development Organization (UNIDO). It has been prepared and streamlined following the extensive consultations with the Government, key national stakeholders and development partners based on the national priority areas and identified high-potential industrial sectors. The CP is aligned with the country#s main development policy frameworks, including the Armenia Transformation Strategy 2050, the Armenia Development Strategy 2014-2025, the Armenia Digital Agenda 2030, the Strategy of the Main Directions Ensuring Economic Development in Agricultural Sector of the Republic of Armenia for 2020-2030, the Energy Development Strategy for Armenia up to 2036, the Gender Policy Strategy and the Action Plan for 2019-2023, the SME Development Strategy for 2020-2024 and the draft Five-Year Industry Development Strategy.
